name: Taiwan Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd. provides property and casualty insurance products and services in Taiwan. It provides fire insurance products, such as residential fire and earthquake, fire and allied perils, commercial fire, household, and fire and property all risks insurance; marine insurance, including marine cargo, inland transit, marine hull, commercial property floater, and fishing vessel insurance; aviation insurance; and automobile insurance comprising physical damage automobile, compulsory automobile liability, theft automobile, automobile insurance and allied perils, and third-party liability automobile insurance.
